limit: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). In each section of S seats, seat at most k guests of category <cat>. All three arguments are required, in this order: category token, k, S.
No table of 7 may have more than 3 investors; tell me each guest's table.
pair: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). Seat every guest of category <catA> directly next to a guest of category <catB> (A, B, A, B, ...).
Put each AI lab guest right beside a chip maker.
apart: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). Keep the guests of company X as far from company Y's guests as the table allows (X at the head, Y at the foot).
Keep Meta and Amazon at opposite ends of the table.
vip: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). Guests whose rank number is R or lower take the first seats; the rest keep their order after them.
Anyone with rank 4 or better goes to the front.
stagger: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). Seat in rounds: each round takes at most m guests from every company; later guests of a company wait for later rounds.
Bring guests in waves, no more than 2 from any one company per wave.
headseat: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). The guest with the lowest rank number takes seat 1; everyone else keeps their order.
Whoever has the smallest rank number gets the first seat.
bigfirst: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). Larger company delegations are seated before smaller ones (ties by company); guests without a company go last.
Companies that brought the most people are seated first.
waitlist: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). Only the first k guests of category <cat> keep their place; further ones of that category go to the very end.
Only the first 3 chip makers get regular seats; the rest wait at the end.
snake: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). Reverse the seat order inside every second section (the 2nd, 4th, ...) of S seats.
Every other table of 6 runs in the opposite direction; which table is each guest at?
sectionlead: ARRANGEMENT word (not a closing word; a closing word line still ends the program). In each section of S seats, the guest with the lowest rank number moves to the section's first seat.
At each table of 5, the lowest-ranked guest takes the head seat; tell me each guest's table.
